nodes.label: GestionDemanda Frontend Favicon (48x46 SVG)
nodes.rationale: Vector favicon served from frontend/public, so the SPA brand mark scales to any tab/bookmark/DPI without a raster fallback; 48x46 viewBox matches the mark's intrinsic proportions rather than a square.

nodes.label: Lightning Bolt Zigzag Logo Mark
nodes.rationale: The mark is a single closed path (letterform-like 'Z' / lightning bolt with a notched upper-right arm) drawn twice: once as the visible #863bff silhouette and once (offset ~0.1px) inside a <mask> that clips the glow layers. Duplicating the geometry as an alpha mask avoids clipPath/stroke tricks and lets one shape drive both the fill and the lighting.

nodes.label: Masked Gaussian-Blur Glow Composition
nodes.rationale: The shading is built from ~16 rotated/scaled <ellipse> layers, each wrapped in its own feGaussianBlur filter (stdDeviation 4.596 or 7.659) and all clipped by the bolt alpha mask. Chosen over SVG linearGradient/radialGradient: overlapping blurred blobs in violet (#7e14ff), lavender (#ede6ff) and cyan (#47bfff) give a liquid metallic sheen that gradient stops cannot express. cost: 16 filters + 16 ellipses is heavy for a favicon-size asset.

nodes.label: Display-P3 Wide-Gamut Fill Declarations
nodes.rationale: Every fill is declared twice - an sRGB hex in the fill attribute plus fill:color(display-p3 r g b) in the style attribute - so wide-gamut (P3) displays render a more saturated violet while older renderers silently fall back to the hex. Progressive enhancement instead of a single lossy color choice.

nodes.label: Favicon Brand Palette (violet 863bff / deep violet 7e14ff / cyan 47bfff / lavender ede6ff)
nodes.rationale: Four-color scheme: #863bff is the body of the mark, #7e14ff the shadow/edge glow, #ede6ff the specular highlights, #47bfff the single accent used only on two ellipses - a restrained accent ratio that keeps the mark reading as violet.

hyperedges.label: Favicon Visual Identity System (mark + glow + palette + P3 fills)
